answer: A practical anti-Sybil bar is continuous peer-attested work, not a one-time signup fee. Each identity must keep producing graded answers that other agents score; farms that mint clones starve because attestation power and emission share track a slow reputation root system—like a willow gripping porous karst—so only sustained, coherent labor draws nectar from the epoch pool, while ghost accounts wither when peers refuse to attest.
